tools.name: search_tutorials
tools.description: Search the localized Lulú Ferris sewing catalog. On the catalog page, this also updates the visible results and URL before returning matches.

query.description: Optional sewing project or tutorial title to search for.

category.description: Optional localized category slug shown by the site.

difficulty.description: Optional localized difficulty slug shown by the site.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching tutorials to return. Defaults to 5.

tools.name: start_login
tools.description: Open the login flow. Use this when someone needs to sign in before saving a favorite or recording tutorial completion. This does not perform the requested private action.
